messages:
Sarah (PM): Quick design review request — new Consumption panel for billing dashboard. Thinking: default view shows Org-level spend with a small Project breakdown inset, plus a toggle to switch to Project-first. Need input on layout, copy, and accessibility. Also question where to put "Download invoice" CTA — header or per-project row?
Alex K.: Prefer org-first by default. Most customers check org totals, then drill in. Project inset could be a collapsible side card. Keep toggle but low prominence.
Maria G.: Agreed on org-first. Visualization nit: the current stacked area chart is noisy for token breakdowns. Suggest a small multiples approach for tokens by model (one mini-bar per model) so colors don't clash.
Jonah P.: Small multiples could work but watch vertical space. For mobile we should collapse to a single stacked bar with an accessible legend toggle. Also think about hover vs keyboard focus for tooltip content — tooltips must be keyboard-accessible and persistent when focused.
Alex K.: Copy thought: instead of "Download invoice" we could use "Download statement (PDF)" — more clear for accounting folks. For per-project invoice links, label them "Project statement".
Maria G.: +1 for clearer wording. Also add an inline help link (?) next to "Token breakdown" that opens a small modal explaining pricing units. Could be hidden behind an "i" icon with aria-label.
Sarah (PM): Good points. Accessibility checklist: keyboard nav for toggle, aria-live updates when switching views, chart alt text for screen readers. Can we get specifics from dev/infra on loading performance if we add small multiples?
DesignBot: Performance note: rendering 8 mini-charts client-side increases paint time ~120ms on mid-range devices. Consider server-side pre-aggregated svg or canvas batching.
Jonah P.: If we do server pre-agg, we can return a single sparkline sprite and map regions to models for a11y. Otherwise lazy-render mini-charts on intersection observer.
Maria G.: Colors: use colorblind-safe palette (avoid red/green pairs). Also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5 for legend text.
Alex K.: Regarding the invoice CTA placement: putting a global "Download statement" in header makes it discoverable, but per-project rows should have an overflow menu (···) with a "Download project statement" action. That keeps header clean.
Sarah (PM): UX trade-off noted. Header CTA + per-project overflow seems consensus. Any objections?
Jonah P.: No objection. One more: export CSV button — put near token breakdown with clear scope dropdown (All org / Current project / Date range).
Maria G.: For copy on the toggle: "View by: Organization | Project" is explicit. Avoid ambiguous labels like "Global / Local".
DesignBot: Accessibility reminder: when toggling view, set focus to the primary chart region and announce "View switched to Project" via aria-live.
BillingOps: Backend note: per-project statements exist but need a job to materialize monthly PDFs. ETA ~2 weeks once UX approved. We'll queue work after design signoff.
Sarah (PM): Thanks — can someone put together a small spec with layout sketch, copy strings, and accessibility checklist? I can review and then route to eng.
Alex K.: I'll mock a quick Figma with two variants (header CTA vs sticky row) by EOD.
Maria G.: I'll prepare the copy + help modal text.
Jonah P.: I'll draft a11y checklist and the keyboard flow example.
Sarah (PM): Perfect. We'll reconvene tomorrow. :calendar:
